sn9.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Kassapagotto Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Kassapagotto divāvihāragato aññataraṃ chetaṃ ovadati || || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmato Kassapagottassa anukampikā atthakāmā āyasmantaṃ Kassapagottaṃ {saṃvejetukāmā} yenāyasmā Kassapagotto tenupasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Kassapagottaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.3:2.1: Giriduggacaraṃ chetaṃ || appapaññam acetasaṃ || akāle ovādaṃ bhikkhu || mando va paṭibhāti maṃ || ||
sn9.3:3.1: suṇoti na vijānāti || āloketi na passati || dhammasmiṃ bhaññamānasmiṃ || atthaṃ bālo na bujjhati || ||
sn9.3:4.1: sace pi dasa pajjote || dhārayissasi Kassapa || n-eva dakkhiti rūpāni || cakkhu hi-ssa na vijjatī ti || ||
sn9.3:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Kassapagotto tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādīti || ||
